sections.content: Use preguntar si for yes/no questions and question words for reported information questions.

items.english: She asked me if I had time.
She asked me where I lived.

items.spanish: El detective preguntó quién había llegado primero.
items.english: The detective asked who had arrived first.

sections.content: A reported question keeps statement word order — me *preguntó* *dónde* *vivía*, not dónde vivía yo — and drops the question marks entirely, since it isn't really a question any more.
